subject: (Possible Bug) Using multiple cores in newest version of RSTAN with old R-Studio, in Windows

messages.author: 4b681bcd9d4d425d
messages.subject: (Possible Bug) Using multiple cores in newest version of RSTAN with old R-Studio, in Windows
parts:
Hi,

Using the most recent version of STAN, but a (much) older version of Rstudio, I have had problems with the namespaces. (It worked before the upgrade on the machine in question, and still works for only 1 core.)

I suspect this is due to the way the viewer is used to show the status - which is greatly appreciated, other than breaking the machine with an old version of Rstudio. I assume the easy way to fix it would be to have a version check before trying to use whatever new feature is used by this.

Specifically, setting cores>1 gives me an error no package 'rstudio' was found, and the analysis does not run. (Also, it may be related to this issue; http://stackoverflow.com/questions/26918639/tilde-expansion-in-rstudio-on-windows)

Now I just need to get the admin for the server to upgrade Rstudio.

Cheers,
David
